featured.title: Evolving Infra: Agent-Adaptive LLM Serving at Scale
featured.tldr: Evolving Infra lets serving nodes switch between prefill and decode in seconds and evicts cached context that no live agent branch needs, cutting latency up to 4.1x versus NVIDIA's Dynamo.

featured.title: SpecOPD: Branch-Parallel On-Policy Distillation for Speculative Decoding
featured.tldr: SpecOPD trains speculative-decoding draft models on their own sampled outputs in parallel branches, lifting accepted-token length by up to 41% and training throughput 16x.

featured.title: FlatCake: A Flat KVCache Storage Architecture for LLM Serving
featured.tldr: FlatCake stores LLM key-value caches on DRAM and SSD as equal peers rather than a DRAM-over-SSD hierarchy, keeping a 94% hit rate on a Claude Code trace where Mooncake falls to 64%.

featured.title: TokenGate: Adapting LLMs for Fast and Memory-Efficient Prefill with Learned Token Pruning
featured.tldr: TokenGate adds a learned gate that prunes long inputs early in a pretrained transformer, cutting time-to-first-token by up to 11.3 times and peak prefill memory by up to 3.4 times with no accuracy loss.

featured.title: Periodic Weak Spots: Phase Sensitivity from Chunked KV-Cache Compression
featured.tldr: Models that compress their KV cache in fixed windows, including DeepSeek-V4, retrieve facts much better at some positions than others, with a period equal to the compression stride, a flaw that average benchmark scores hide.
